cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: an oyster bar — an ice-filled counter of shells, lemon wedges, a stainless prep table and hanging net decorations
cuts.scene: she is the owner of the oyster bar sitting upright on a stool, resting a moment while the ice counter is prepared
cuts.outfit: an oyster shucker look fitted to her body — a short striped apron over a fitted crop top and short shorts, bare midriff and legs, a pearl necklace and spiked shell-shaped pin
